To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) psychological factors play a role in the majority of medical presentations and (b) the majority of patients who present to medical settings have psychological factors that are associated with their presentation.
the psychological factors are important in medical presentations.

(1) psychological factors are a significant cause of medical presentations, (2) psychological factors are associated with increased medical service utilization, (3) the pathways through which psychological factors lead patients to seek medical care are complex, (4) the impact of psychological factors on medical presentations is not limited to primary presentations, but also includes secondary and complex presentations, and (5) the pathways by which psychological and medical factors interact are important to consider in the assessment and treatment of patients with medical problems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between psychological factors and medical presentations.
the relationship between psychological factors and medical presentations and the role that psychological factors play in medical utilization.
the role of psychological factors in the presentation of medical problems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the role of psychological factors in the presentation of medical problems is a very complex one.
the psychological factors play a major role in medical presentations and the impact of these factors is often not well understood by the medical community.
psychological factors are involved in the presentation and course of virtually all medical problems and in the presentation of virtually all psychological problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
patients with psychological factors in medical presentation are more likely to have multiple medical problems, are more likely to use more medical services and are more likely to be hospitalized.
psychological factors play a significant role in medical presentations.
the presentation of a psychological disorder can result in the presentation of medical problems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
psychological factors are important in understanding and addressing medical presentations.
psychological factors can be a primary, secondary, or complex contributor to medical presentations.
a large number and variety of medical presentations have psychological underpinnings.
